parsed.reason: The Arabic text conveys all the facts accurately: the intro was closed after their earlier no, it cannot be reopened, saying yes now changes nothing, the parent is still open to other introductions, and Hale will text them when it finds a good match. No invented details, no extra promises, no unrequested apology (للأسف is mild regret, not an apology for a mistake). It uses the plural/formal كم with no gender assumption. The register is clear and polite but slightly formal and stiff for a friend texting; هيل is also left unmarked as a name, and قبل قليل (a little while ago) adds a small time detail not in the facts. Overall natural and correct, just a bit formal.
